title: Changelog
text: Compiled C/C++ provenance core (src/rmbl_core.cpp, registered via useDynLib + .Call): SHA-256 hashing summary statistics (mean, variance, correlation, normal PDF). authoring package compiled; generated bundle stays pure-R reviewer. Cross-platform brick-proof orchestrator (setup_and_run.R) — pure R, shell dependencies (bundle launcher, package). OS launchers — START_HERE.command (macOS), START_HERE.bat (Windows), start_here.sh (Linux). route orchestrator. Reusable R libraries: lib_helpers.R, lib_data_loader.R, lib_synthetic.R, lib_manifest.R. CKAN open-data resolution: package_show slug + name pattern, package_search fallback. SHA256 verification pinned provenance manifest. Schema validation: required columns (fatal), value sets (warning), row-count bounds (warning). Synthetic-data fallback offline / -data review. Constrained save-location menu: bundle / Downloads / Documents / R-policy / custom. “EVERYTHING GO” startup panel absolute paths contacted endpoints. SUMMARY.txt written every results folder. SECURITY.md template addressing common “safe” concerns including .tar.gz = malware misconception. DATA_NOTICE.md template vendored open-data attribution. Templated docs: README.md, INSTRUCTIONS.txt, SECURITY.md, DATA_NOTICE.md. make_bundle.sh — CLI: config + provenance + scripts → shippable zip. verify_bundle.sh — author-side audit: extract, run, parse manifest, exit non-zero regression. examples/otis-mrp/ — complete reference example using Ontario’s open OTIS A01RCDD data. Documentation: quickstart, customization, data sources, FAQ.

title: Building reproducible data capsules
text: Everything starts data_provenance.json file: machine-readable pin project’s data source. records portal endpoint, pattern identifying right resource, expected SHA256, schema data must satisfy, recipe synthesizing stand-.
code: prov_json <- '{   "dataset": {     "title": "Demo library statistics",     "ckan_api_endpoint": "https://data.ontario.ca/api/3/action/package_show?id=ontario-public-library-statistics"   },   "resource": { "name_match_pattern": "2014" },   "schema": {     "expected_columns": ["year", "visits", "alert"],     "structural_invariants": { "min_data_rows": 5 },     "expected_value_sets": { "year": [2024, 2025] },     "synthetic_recipe": {       "n_rows": 25,       "seed": 42,       "columns": {         "year":   { "type": "sample",    "values": [2024, 2025] },         "visits": { "type": "poisson",   "lambda": 3, "min": 1 },         "alert":  { "type": "bernoulli", "p": 0.2 },         "id":     { "type": "id_pattern", "pattern": "p-{seq:05d}" }       }     }   } }'  prov_path <- file.path(tempdir(), "data_provenance.json") writeLines(prov_json, prov_path)  prov <- load_provenance(prov_path) prov$dataset$title #> [1] "Demo library statistics"

title: Building reproducible data capsules
text: Every file gets SHA256; every data frame checked pinned schema. validate_schema() reports issues without raising, callers choose severity response; apply_schema_validation() strict wrapper (fatal issues stop, drift warns).
code: digest <- sha256_file(data_path) substr(digest, 1, 16) #> [1] "e2f4b6752a2e3b56"  chk <- verify_sha256(data_path, digest) chk$match #> [1] TRUE  issues <- validate_schema(df, prov) length(issues)   # 0 = clean against the pinned schema #> [1] 0

title: Building reproducible data capsules
text: make_manifest() + record() accumulate named cross-checks (PASS / DIFFER / INFO), writers produce two capsule artifacts: machine-readable manifest.json human-readable SUMMARY.txt. capsule directory now contains everything reviewer needs trace run: exact inputs, digests, every cross-check status, plain-language account — reproducible years later even portal moved .
code: man <- make_manifest(   list(project = "demo-study", author = "A. Author", synthetic = TRUE),   environment = FALSE  # TRUE also snapshots R/OS/package versions )  man <- record(man, "rows_generated", observed = gen$rows, expected = 25) #>   rows_generated                               observed = 25.0000      expected = 25.0000      [PASS] man <- record(man, "mean_visits",               observed = mean(df$visits), expected = 3,               tol = 1, synthetic = TRUE) #>   mean_visits                                  observed = 2.8000       expected = 3.0000       [INFO]  out_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "capsule-demo") dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)  write_manifest_json(man, file.path(out_dir, "manifest.json")) summary_path <- write_summary_txt(   man, out_dir,   paths = list(input = data_path, results = out_dir),   what_was_done = c("* generated synthetic stand-in (real source offline)",                     "* validated schema and recorded cross-checks") )  cat(readLines(summary_path)[7:12], sep = "\n") #> Project:   demo-study #> Author:    A. Author #> When:      2026-07-10 04:38:01 UTC #> OS:        Linux #> R:         R version 4.6.1 (2026-06-24) #> Mode:      SYNTHETIC (not real data -- pipeline check only)

title: Reproducible Data Capsules with Provenance and Fallback
text: Brick-proof, reproducible data capsules R. rmoriebricklayer resolves open-data sources, records verifies provenance, validates downloaded data pinned schema, falls back schema-driven synthetic data real source unreachable — analysis result can traced back exact inputs.

title: Reproducible Data Capsules with Provenance and Fallback
text: CKAN resolution — resolve_via_ckan() / resolve_via_ckan_search() locate resources portal’s package_show / package_search endpoints. Provenance — load_provenance(), make_manifest(), record(), write_manifest_json(), write_summary_txt() capture every run manifest plus plain-language summary. Integrity — sha256_file() / verify_sha256() hash verify downloads; download_data() / friendly_download() fetch Wayback Machine fallback. Schema validation — validate_schema() / apply_schema_validation() check data pinned schema. Synthetic fallback — make_synthetic_column() / make_synthetic_csv() generate schema-driven stand-ins real source , pipeline still runs end--end.

Supported types "sample" (categorical, optionally weighted), "bernoulli" (two-label draw optional per-row base rate), "poisson" (counts floor), "id_pattern" (templated IDs, optionally per-year sequenced), "sequence" (running integer sequence).

Defaults empty list. base_p Optional numeric vector per-row latent propensities used "bernoulli" type add row-level variation.

title: rmoriebricklayer 0.3.1
text: License wording corrected: optional rmorie CLI agent_bundle() forwards AGPL-3.0--later (entire MORIE family AGPL; earlier internal comment mislabelled proprietary). Package moved bricklayer/ subdirectory repository root (required rOpenSci’s review tooling); repo-level extras stay .Rbuildignored siblings. New vignette capsules.Rmd walking essential flow offline: provenance pin -> schema validation -> SHA256 integrity -> synthetic fallback -> manifest + summary. Every exported function now runnable @examples (network calls \donttest; offline NULL-contracts shown runnable). README gained development-version install instructions. New CI: test coverage (covr + Codecov) rOpenSci pkgcheck. Test coverage raised 84 percent 96 percent: offline tests CKAN/Socrata/ArcGIS resolver success paths, friendly_download diagnostics Wayback retry, summary contact/licence blocks, pinned script hashes, multi-block SHA-256 path. Dead requireNamespace guards Imports (digest, jsonlite) removed. Repo-level LICENSE text excluded build (License: AGPL-3 canonical spec; stray file triggered check NOTE).

title: rmoriebricklayer 0.3.0
text: New verify_capsule(): one call re-verifies entire reproducible data capsule offline — provenance readability, pinned sha256/size/row count, schema validity, script hash, re-derivation every stored manifest cross-check numbers. New capture_environment() records R version, platform, OS, UTC timestamp, loaded package versions; make_manifest() now attaches default (environment = FALSE opt ). New cite_capsule() generates ready--paste data citation (text + BibTeX @misc, DOI-aware) provenance object.

title: rmoriebricklayer 0.3.0
text: New resolve_via_socrata() resolve_via_arcgis() extend URL-rot recovery beyond CKAN Socrata (Calgary/Chicago/NYC) ArcGIS FeatureServer (Toronto Police Service) portals MORIE family fetches .

title: rmoriebricklayer 0.2.5
text: make_synthetic_column("id_pattern") without year_col now returns n ids (vectorised-gsub misuse returned single id). bernoulli columns unlist JSON-derived labels, fixing mangled column names provenance-parsed schemas. Single-value row_replication longer trips base R’s scalar sample() expansion. Test suite grown 9 43 behavioural tests covering full export surface (provenance, CKAN guards, Wayback handling, offline file:// downloads, sha256, schema validation, manifests, synthetic generation, RNG hygiene).

title: rmoriebricklayer 0.2.4
text: make_synthetic_csv() now restores caller’s .Random.seed exit (CRAN policy: lasting RNG-state change). First CRAN submission prep: cran-comments.md, build exclusions.
